text:
samira_docs: Heads-up: PR #4521 is ready (migration guide + SDK snippet updates). Vercel preview loads but a WASM helper (`wasm-utils-1.2.0.wasm`) is 404ing on the preview runner. Need a tech reviewer and a merge slot (aiming for 05:45 UTC deployment). Preview: https://preview-4521--redwood-docs.vercel.app/migration/private-networking :eyes:

ci-bot: Build finished with warnings. Asset missing: /assets/wasm-utils-1.2.0.wasm (404) during runtime fetch. Full logs: https://vercel-logs.example/4521

carl_platform: odd. Did the build pipeline copy WASM artifacts into `site/assets/`? Sometimes our mkdocs plugin skips binary blobs unless explicitly whitelisted. Can you paste the `mkdocs.yml` includes you used for the wasm fetch?

samira_docs: snippet in `migration/index.md` uses the loader: `fetch('/assets/wasm-utils-1.2.0.wasm')` and we ship the wasm in `docs/assets/wasm/wasm-utils-1.2.0.wasm` in the repo. MkDocs build output locally contains `site/assets/wasm/wasm-utils-1.2.0.wasm` so I expected the preview to serve it.

kate_pm: PM check: we need the migration guide live before the Monday sync so the 05:45 slot is important. If preview stays flaky we can merge but SRE will watch the staging deploy.

carl_platform: quick checks: 1) Vercel preview may GZIP or change path for wasm; ensure the fetch `accept-encoding` isn't required. 2) On preview, check the Network tab to see the actual request path — it might be `/docs/assets/...` if base urls are different. 3) Run `mkdocs build --clean && ls -R site/assets/wasm` locally to confirm file exists.

samira_docs: local commands for repro if anyone wants to test:
```
git fetch origin pull/4521/head:pr-4521
git checkout pr-4521
pip install -r requirements.txt
mkdocs build --clean
ls -l site/assets/wasm
python -m http.server --directory site 8003
# open http://localhost:8003/migration/private-networking
```

vercel-bot: Redeploy triggered for preview-4521.

ci-bot: Note: preview runner rewrites absolute assets when `site_url` is set. If `site_url` is `https://docs.redwood.ai` but preview serves under a different origin, some absolute references may fail. Prefer relative asset paths in snippets.

samira_docs: I pushed a tiny change to the loader to use a relative path `fetch('assets/wasm/wasm-utils-1.2.0.wasm')` instead of leading slash and re-triggered. Also added a short note in the PR about WASM placement for docs authors.

vercel-bot: Redeploy succeeded for preview-4521  available at https://preview-4521--redwood-docs.vercel.app/migration/private-networking :white_check_mark:

samira_docs: great! can someone from platform review so I can schedule the merge at 05:45 UTC? Tagging @carl_platform and @kate_pm for timing.

carl_platform: reviewing now. small nit: the Rust SDK snippet still uses `unwrap()` in the example; prefer `?` with a short note. Not blocking for the migration guide. Approved from infra after that tweak.

kate_pm: reviewed for content and verified the examples match the API contract. approved. Please include the local repro steps in the PR description so support can reproduce if needed.

samira_docs: thanks all. I'll queue the merge for 05:45 UTC and ping here immediately after. If the staging deploy fails, we'll roll back and schedule a hotfix window.

ci-bot: Reminder: to abort the production deploy after merge comment `ci-bot: abort deploy` within 10 minutes of merge. Also, merging outside the 04:00-08:00 UTC window requires an explicit SRE ack in this thread.

samira_docs: noted. merging at the slot unless anyone objects. final sanity-check please. :pray:
